purpose: Record the God Mode feature additions as a release-note-ready changelog without claiming release readiness before validation, commit, push, and CI evidence exist.

entries.title: Dashboard God Mode cockpit surfaces
entries.summary: Adds visible dashboard panels for God Mode developer state, module coverage, release readiness, validation plan, work package, ADR workflow, ecosystem lanes, handoff, completion audit, run state, and staging manifest.

entries.title: Goals evidence ledger
entries.summary: Adds source-controlled goal evidence with acceptance criteria, validation commands, rollback, and evidence links.

entries.title: Repository health manifest
entries.summary: Adds repo health lanes for apps, packages, plugins, docs, agents, CI governance, security gates, and rollback posture.

entries.title: Living governance index
entries.summary: Adds a governance index that links architecture, quality, God Mode, module coverage, goals, repos, agents, release readiness, validation, work package, ADR, handoff, audit, run state, staging, and changelog docs.

entries.title: Agent lane status
entries.summary: Adds safe autonomy lane status for God Mode Developer, Focus Mode, Master Prompt Governance, Security Review, and GitHub Workflow.

entries.title: Release readiness gates
entries.summary: Adds explicit Security, AI Policy, Quality Evidence, Rollback, and CI Readiness gates.

entries.title: Validation plan
entries.summary: Adds ordered validation commands and proof targets for the God Mode work package.

entries.title: ADR workflow
entries.summary: Adds ADR template, ADR workflow, and ADR-0001 for the SEIS God Mode operating system decision.

entries.title: Handoff standard
entries.summary: Adds handoff requirements for summary, changed surfaces, validation status, risks, rollback, next commands, and protected user work.

entries.title: Completion audit
entries.summary: Adds a not-complete audit that blocks completion claims until validation, commit, push, CI, and protected-user-work evidence exist.

entries.title: Run-state ledger
entries.summary: Adds pending-validation execution state for artifacts, runtime surfaces, telemetry contracts, validation, commit boundary, push/CI, and protected user work.

entries.title: Staging manifest
entries.summary: Adds planned-not-staged commit boundary groups, protected paths, and excluded-until-review categories.

entries.title: Feature Growth Ledger
entries.summary: Adds topic-by-topic God Mode improvement evidence for Dashboard, Goals, Repos, Docs, Agents, Security, AI Policy, Rollback, Validation, and Handoff.

releaseBlockers: Validation commands have not been refreshed after the feature growth ledger addition.
Full quality governance has not been rerun after the feature growth ledger addition.
Commit staging has not been finalized.
Changes have not been pushed or verified by CI.
completionRule: The changelog is release-note-ready only after all entries have evidence, required gates pass, staging is reviewed, and release blockers are resolved.
